description: Jordan Reyes sends the cold email to Mark Cuban's public email address.
The email arrives at Mark Cuban's email server and is placed in his inbox.
The email remains in Mark Cuban's inbox, unread.
Mark Cuban glances at his inbox and sees the email from Jordan Reyes with the subject line referencing Cost Plus Drugs, but he does not open it now.
Mark Cuban closes his inbox and moves on to other tasks, leaving the email unread.
